title: Read complete story revisions and lifecycle ancestry
preconditions: Use an isolated Saga with a feature, existing persona, and story S at revision r1 and lifecycle proposed; save its full public query definition.

steps.action: Revise S through story revise as r2 with parent r1, changed title/statement and criterion wording; query requirement-history for S through every cursor.
steps.expected_result: History includes unchanged complete r1 and complete r2, and r2 names r1 as parent.

steps.action: Append accepted with parent proposed and reason "Agreed scope"; query requirement-history again through every cursor.
steps.expected_result: Both events remain present with their states, the reason on accepted, and the proposed parent on accepted.

expected_result: Definition and lifecycle history retain exact earlier content and graph ancestry.
